assessments.name: Module 1 Assignment: Forensic Toxicology Lesson A: The Effects of Illegal Drugs upon the Human Body
rubricLanguage: Explain three reasons the initial screening for drugs or poisons must be followed by  confirmation testing.

The general symptoms caused by each (2 marks)

• The general symptoms caused by depressants include drowsiness, sleep, insensitivity, and relaxation. (1 mark)

• The general symptoms caused by stimulants include increased alertness, increased

metabolism, hyperactivity, stimulation of sexual arousal, and prevention of hunger. (1 mark)

State one possible reason drug-testing devices are not widely used by Canadian law enforcement agencies today. (2 marks)

Any of the following answers is acceptable for 2 marks:

Drug-testing devices are not widely used by Canadian law enforcement agencies today for several reasons:

• They are time consuming because drug-testing of urine and /or blood must be done in a hospital setting.

They cannot be done on the roadside or at a police station.

• No legislation currently exists that allows for roadside drug-testing.

• The results are not 100% accurate.
They must do so voluntarily.

Why is mass spectrometry considered the most accurate method of confirmation testing in forensic toxicology? (3 marks)

• Every drug, toxin, or poison produces a distinct fragmentation pattern according to its unique individual chemical structure.

• No two patterns are exactly alike.
